concept.title: Bluetooth Calling Features of the Multi-Function Button:
concept.shortdesc: This button also has multiple features for Bluetooth calling allowing for hands-free operation and minimal distractions.

image.alt: Image labeling multi-function button on the device.

ul.li: Long Press 1x to activate Voice Control (i.e. Siri/Google Assistant))
Short Press 2x to redial the last phone number called.
